mobbin:9649cfdc-dbbd-4c86-8a2d-9cdd25395.summary: User lands on Get started (plan minutes remaining), then opens Insights → Rooms to search rooms and see last active, participant minutes, and session counts.
steps: Get started — Free plan 2000 participant minutes + create room CTAs
Insights Rooms — searchable table: name, Last active, PM used, Sessions
steal: Sidebar/plan chip shows remaining participant minutes as always-visible utilisation budget (steps 0–1).
Rooms list KPIs: Last active + PM used + Sessions per room (step 1).
Inline definition via PM tooltip affordance on column header (step 1).
avoid: Flow opens on onboarding Welcome before Insights (step 0) — don’t bury utilisation behind a get-started hub.
mobbin:9649cfdc-dbbd-4c86-8a2d-9cdd25395.fit: Direct analog for sim-room utilisation: room list → minutes/sessions; extends Essentials toward calendar-generated room-hour KPIs.

mobbin:df187e39-3913-4484-8e5e-6af9a2f54.summary: User opens Insights Rooms, reveals PM = Participant Minutes tooltip, then drills into Room details with overview cards and per-session PM log.
steps: Insights Rooms list — room row with PM used / Sessions
PM tooltip — Participant Minutes = sum of participant time
Room details — Sessions / Unique participants / PM used + session table
steal: Explicit PM definition tooltip before/while reading the metric (step 1).
Room details: three overview KPIs then session rows with Duration, Participants, PM used (step 2).
Back to Rooms breadcrumb + copyable room name (step 2).
mobbin:df187e39-3913-4484-8e5e-6af9a2f54.fit: Best first-cut pattern for room utilisation drill-down: list → defined minute unit → session ledger; no report builder.
